title: SAFER: Advancing Safety Alignment via Efficient Ex-Ante Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for LLMs by embedding explicit safety rules into a multi-stage reasoning process. These rules cover various ethical and moral domains, including prohibitions against violence, hate speech, and discrimination based on protected attributes like religion. It utilizes safety and harmlessness benchmarks (such as PKU-SafeRLHF and HH-RLHF) to evaluate the model's adherence to these human values.
